item.title: States Weekly: October 14, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers October 14, 2026.

item.title: Diplomacy or Coercion?
item.description: In this week’s column, Bill Reinsch discusses how Trump’s coercive trade policies played out at the recent G20 foreign ministers’ meeting.

item.title: CSIS Names Chris Fall Vice President of the Economic Security and Technology Department
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies today announced that Dr. Chris Fall has joined the Economic Security and Technology Department as vice president.

item.title: Allison Minor Joins CSIS Middle East Program as Senior Fellow
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) today announced that Allison Minor has joined the CSIS Middle East Program as a senior fellow.

item.title: The U.S. and Korea Should Be Bold in Their Investments
item.description: Seoul and Washington should dedicate a portion of the investments to projects that will improve national security and supply chain security even if they entail accepting some commercial risk.

item.title: Does Health Research Reach Washington? A Conversation on Evidence, Policy, and the Gap Between Them | CSIS-WashU Workshop
item.description: The CSIS Bipartisan Alliance for Global Health Security and the WashU Bursky School of Public Health hosted an event focused on the role of universities in strengthening the connection between research evidence and policy action.
